subject: IME kickoff - forecasts you can explain to an auditor
body:
Team,

Kicking off IME. Our open-source Interpretable Mixture of Experts work gives us a forecasting architecture where the experts themselves are interpretable models and an assignment module (interpretable linear, or black-box LSTM) routes each sample - crucially, to a single expert at inference time, so every prediction comes with a readable explanation of which regime produced it.

Product motivation: internal forecasting consumers (capacity planning, spend forecasting) keep asking for explanations their reviewers will accept. IME is the credible middle ground between 'linear model everywhere' and 'trust the LSTM'.

Scope: reproduce the released results on the Electricity (ECL) and Rossmann datasets with both IME_WW and IME_BW variants at num_experts=20, then evaluate on one internal forecasting workload. Milestones: repro by mid-June, internal-workload eval by mid-July, recommendation by 2026-07-27.

Kaia leads modeling, Amara infra, Efe evaluation methodology. Jelena - resourcing note please.

Dmitri
